source_review.scope: Three added lines (two comments and marked_deletion) plus one predicate change inside parse_unified_diff's Git mail signature detection.
findings: The exemption requires both pending old-side records and an immediate exact no-newline marker. In that case the delimiter-looking deleted source line reaches existing body accounting, reducing old_left once; the annotation itself consumes no source count.
The old_left > 0 condition matters: after a completed hunk the same marker text can be an authored mail signature. Those real Git-produced signatures remain footer metadata.

Outstanding old or new counts still trigger the existing incomplete-hunk refusal after the source annotation; the source-only review also inspected the owner's damaged-count tests and their no-source-read check.
All header/path decoding, hunk accounting, final completion checks, functions_touching, changed_functions, source admission and alias-related code outside the predicate remain exact original bytes.

The 13 parametrized owner cases cover unsigned LF/CRLF and terminal-LF transport, real signatures with/without source EOF markers, a later-file body, actual file/stdin CLI routes and missing-count refusal. The new CLI helper explicitly passes -O when its own interpreter is optimized; no child optimization is inferred from a parent-only flag.

independent_execution.fixtures: Two independently authored private Git repositories. source_eof changes sample.py and empties a file whose final line is '- ' without LF; signature_eof changes sample.py only. Each supplies unsigned, default-signed and explicit EOF-marker-signed format-patch output.
independent_execution.results: All six candidate mail patches pass git apply --reverse --check and produce the same normalized FileChange records and exact sample.py:selected ChangedFunction as their plain-diff controls. Original unsigned source-EOF mail refuses at record24 as a premature signature; its other five controls pass.

limits: Independent receiving is normal Python only. It is not an independent -O run, actual TestPilot CLI course, maintained pytest suite rerun, or whole-repository qualification.
Owner-reported pytest/CLI results keep their producer attribution. The source reviewer inspected the tests but does not substitute that reading for their execution.
The independent fixtures, saved patches and commands are authored local data. No user's repository content or application state was mutated.
The historical driver embeds its receiver path and source pins. Replay requires deliberate path adaptation, a new harness identity, fresh fixtures/output names and preservation of earlier records.

This review accepts the exact source/test/patch identities above. Later unrelated source composition requires its own source equivalence or receiving; integration and installed adoption remain with the established owner.
